headline: DC announces rebooted Absolute Justice roster
post:
Get ready for a massive shake-up in the DC Universe! According to Screen Rant, a brand-new team of heroes is uniting in "Absolute Justice", an upcoming event comic arriving in April 2027 from Jason Aaron and Juan Ferreyra. 

This new roster features iconic characters with wild redesigns and major power shifts. Absolute Superman's cape is made of "Sunstone Dust" that shapes into weaponry, while Absolute Wonder Woman was raised by Circe and wields three distinct lassos. Meanwhile, Absolute Batman relies on civil engineering skills and a cape with a "Bat-Thumb", and Wally West's speed connects to the chaotic "Still Point" energy. The team also includes Jo Mullein as Green Lantern and John Jones as Martian Manhunter, fighting against a continuity where villains have already claimed the "Justice League" name.

Which of these wild new hero powers are you most excited to see in action?

#AbsoluteJustice #DCComics #JusticeLeague
original_title: DC Officially Announces Rebooted Justice League Roster, All Members And Powers

headline: Black Cat joins elite Marvel team history
post:
Black Cat just pulled off a surprising superhero trifecta, according to Screen Rant. Emma Frost recruits Felicia Hardy for a covert mission to infiltrate Cyclops's Alaskan X-Men base and steal an experimental Sentinel processor. While Marvel officially confirmed she does not become a permanent member, this undercover assignment makes her an honorary X-Man. 

This thrilling update puts Felicia in rare company alongside icons like Wolverine and Storm. Years earlier, she earned official clearance to work alongside the Avengers during storylines like Beyond and MacKay’s Avengers tie-ins. More recently, she became an honorary member of the Fantastic Four during the Queen in Black crossover event to help stop Hela. 

Only legendary heroes like Logan and Ororo Munroe have genuinely held official membership across all three of these major Marvel squads. Even though Black Cat remains an honorary member of the teams, her impressive comic book record continues to grow. 🐱

What is your favorite team-up in Marvel history?

#BlackCat #XMen #MarvelComics
original_title: Marvel’s Newest Anti-Hero To Join The X-Men, Avengers, And Fantastic Four Is the Last Person Fans Expect

headline: Joel Schumacher almost passed on Jim Carrey
post:
Did you know that director Joel Schumacher nearly didn't cast Jim Carrey as the Riddler in 1995's Batman Forever? At the time, the director felt the actor was too young for the role.

Everything changed when Schumacher saw the trailer for The Mask. Seeing Carrey bring that comic book to life convinced the director to bring him on board to face Val Kilmer's Bruce Wayne! 🎭

What is your favorite memory of Jim Carrey in Batman Forever?

#BatmanForever #JimCarrey #TheMask
original_title: Batman Forever's Director Nearly Rejected Jim Carrey As The Riddler Until He Saw This Movie
